about_the_game:
This is a turret defense game.

This is an exciting tower defense game where players are placed in an open green field with a winding path composed of white squares. Enemies will attack along this path. At the beginning of the game, players have a certain amount of funds and need to plan reasonably, making choices from defense towers with different prices and placing them in suitable grid positions.

In the game, enemies come in a variety of shapes, including small and agile ground monsters, as well as aerial enemies with flying abilities. They surge in waves, attacking the player's defense system. Each defense tower has its own characteristics. Basic defense towers can carry out routine attacks, while advanced defense towers have stronger firepower, longer range, or special attack effects. As the game progresses, players obtain funds by eliminating enemies, which can be used to upgrade defense towers or deploy new towers to cope with increasingly powerful enemy attacks. The game tests players' strategic planning ability. How to build efficient defense layouts with limited funds and adjust tower defense combinations according to enemy types is the key to victory, full of fun and challenges in strategic gaming.
